title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-18
lineage: SBD > MR > Reel > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording with a rough audience‑only first half but crisp soundboard later captures an electrifying second set highlighted by a monster Other One and marathon Good Lovin'.
ai_review.review: The tape opens with a noisy audience recording that many find “crummy,” but once the soundboard kicks in the band erupts – Jerry’s solo on St. Stephen, a soaring 19‑minute Dancin’ St. Stephen > Not Fade Away, and an epic 21‑minute Good Lovin' showcase his fire. The second set also delivers strong moments like The Other One, Me & My Uncle, Operator and a tight Sugar Magnolia, all rendered with near‑perfect DAT quality, making the show a must‑listen despite the uneven first half.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is rated very highly (outstanding song selection and jams) while recording quality is mixed (poor audience portion, excellent soundboard later); weighted average yields a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First set captured from the crowd – muffled, noisy and typical of early‑70s audience tapes. From mid‑set onward the soundboard (DAT) is crisp, balanced and near‑perfect, with Phil’s bass loud and clear.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A rough, crowd‑filled first half gives way to a soaring second set; long jams flow seamlessly and the energy builds toward an unforgettable climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry lets loose with a blistering solo on St. Stephen and drives the 19‑minute Dancin’ jam, delivering a spectacular Other One.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass comes through loud and clear in this recording – unusually prominent for an early‑70s audience tape.
